facts.text: NSEA Protector built from the TV set
facts.why: The Thermians made a working copy of the Protector from the show's broadcasts. It was not built from the TV set.
facts.fix: NSEA Protector rebuilt from the TV show

vibe.verdict: A great ship's ration sheet with proper form language, but the food is generic and it leaves out the best lines and creatures.
missing: Jason fighting the rock creature, Fred beams him up (the planet)
Guy Fleegman as Crewman Number 6 (the bridge)
Omega 13 sending everyone back 13 seconds (the bridge)
Alexander leading the Thermian revolt (the ship)
ideas: Swap 'Jason's morning after turkey club' note for 'Picked up hungover, still thinks it is a set'.
Replace 'Thermian pink raspberry marshmallows' with 'Crewman 6 jelly' for Guy.
Add a '13 second' timer stamp on the crew badge in place of 'Commander Taggart'.
Swap the 'Rock monster crackers' note to say Jason is left behind with it.
